title: Secondary Outburst
summary: Secondary Outburst is a Secondary Arcane that consumes all melee combo multipliers to increase secondary weapon Critical Chance and Critical Damage upon swapping to a secondary weapon.
extract:
Secondary Outburst is a Secondary Arcane that consumes all melee combo multipliers to increase secondary weapon Critical Chance and Critical Damage upon swapping to a secondary weapon.

Effect

Acquisition
May appear as a Steel Path Circuit Tier 1, 3, 4, 6, or 7 reward on a weekly rotational basis.
May be sold by Acrithis for 10  Pathos Clamps on a daily rotational basis, requiring Drifter Intrinsics Opportunity Rank 9 for the arcanes to appear in her shop.
May drop from Undercroft portals in the Duviri Experience while on Steel Path.

Notes
The values are additive with mods like  Pistol Gambit and  Target Cracker.
While the buff is active, swapping to secondary will not override the Outburst buff unless it would provide a higher buff than the active one.
For example, if the current buff is +100% (swapping from a 5x combo), the arcane will not override the buff if current combo level is 5x or below when the weapon swap occurs.
Melee combo is consumed every time the player swaps to a secondary with Outburst.
The buff does not affect any of the secondary exalted weapons if the arcane is not equipped directly on secondary exalted weapons.
It is not possible to consume combo count from both a normal and exalted melee simultaneously, only whichever is currently active.
The  Venka Prime's increased maximum combo count works with this arcane, allowing for a slightly larger buff than is possible with other melee weapons.
On the other hand, the  Dex Nikana's reduced maximum combo count also works with this arcane, allowing for a slightly weaker buff but much easier to achieve (121 combo count for 220% vs 240 for regular weapons for 240%), especially with initial combo bonus.

Tips
Can use the Gun and Blade perk of  Ceramic Dagger Incarnon as well as  Corrupt Charge and  Covert Lethality.
The full effect can be obtained through  Melee Crescendo, which is easily stacked by opening enemies to ground finishers with ragdoll grouping from Void Snare,  Airburst,  Coil Horizon,  Pull, etc.

Bugs
Still incorrectly provides the buff, again only for Clients, and seemingly only when using Gunblades. Specifically,  Vastilok and  Redeemer Prime were used in testing.
The buff activates when swapping to your secondary in the Arsenal while the player has an equipped melee weapon with any initial combo.
The game only applies and updates the UI for the largest buff value, but still creates smaller value buffs every time a secondary weapon swap occurs.
For example, if the arcane triggers at 4x while a 10x buff is active, Outburst will still create a buff for the 4x instance, without any UI elements updating. After the 10x buff expires, the next largest buff, the 4x buff, will be active on the weapon until it expires.
Every time that the arcane triggers, a removal check occurs 30 seconds later which removes any Outburst buff with the same value as the one created by the trigger.
For example, if an arcane triggers at 4x while a 4x buff is already active, it will create a second instance of the 4x buff. But when the first buff expires, all 4x buffs will be deleted, even if they had more duration left.
This can be an issue for players that make use of Initial Combo, as they'll typically keep triggering Outburst at the same value, and especially if they are repeatedly triggering Outburst, which in turn causes frequent removal checks.
